name: devin-quota-status
description: Live Devin daily/weekly quota percentages in the status bar (polls api.devin.ai via a stdlib Python helper).

devinQuota.pythonPath.description: Python 3 interpreter used to run quota.py. Empty = auto-detect (python/python3/py on PATH, then common install dirs). The Windows Store 'python' alias stub is ignored.

devinQuota.warnPercent.description: Show a warning notification when daily or weekly quota reaches this percentage

devinQuota.logPath.description: CSV path for the quota-percentage time series (row appended when the pct changes or hourly). Empty = log to the extension's global storage; 'off' disables logging.
